predictions.articleTitle: Central Espanol vs Boston River Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Home Urgency Blunt Away Quality?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Draw / Away Win (with Boston River victory leading) and Under 2.5 goals provide the strongest alignment with the 2.39 combined goal expectancy and Central Espanol's 0.62-goal attacking ceiling.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win captures 74.3% of the independent Poisson baseline across Boston River's superior Clausura goal differential and Central Espanol's home survival resistance (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Goals aligns with a 57.3% Poisson probability and Central Espanol's 8 goals in 13 league matches (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
1:1 Draw hedge protects against Boston River's 55.6% big-chances-missed ratio and 89-hour post-cup fatigue (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
